notes: RSI seed: first 14 close-to-close changes have gains summing to 9 and losses summing to 5, so RSI at index 14 is 100 * 9 / 14. The next change is +2, and the Wilder step is (13 * prior + current) / 14. ATR smoothing uses true range 1 on bars 1..14 (seed 1 at index 14) and true range 15 on bar 15, so index 15 is (13 * 1 + 15) / 14 = 2. Flat closes are 50, a strictly rising seed is 100, and a strictly falling seed is 0.
